Who can use Metrado

Metrado is a tool for businesses and self-employed tradespeople. You must be at least 18 (or the age of majority where you live) and use Metrado for your trade or business.

The service

Metrado helps you measure jobs, price them from your own rates, send quotes and proposals, record approvals, and issue invoices and receipts. It is a calculation and document tool. It does not file taxes, submit documents to any tax authority, or give legal, tax or financial advice. We may improve or change features.

No account

You can use Metrado without an account. Your content is stored on your device. Settings › Data › Delete all data removes it, and you can read how in the data deletion page.

Subscriptions

  • Metrado Pro is an auto-renewing subscription sold through the App Store. The price, billing period and any trial are shown before you buy. Payment is taken by Apple, and the subscription renews unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period in your Apple ID settings. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription.
  • Trials are for eligible new subscribers. We remind you in the app before a trial converts to a paid plan.
  • Refunds are handled by Apple under its policies.
  • Prices vary by region and may change. If you are subscribed, Apple tells you about price changes as its rules require.

Your content

You own the content you create in Metrado. We do not receive it unless you send it to us. You can export your documents at any time. You are responsible for backing up your phone.

Quotes, measurements and prices are your responsibility

Metrado calculates prices from the measurements and rates you enter or accept. Regional default rates, coverage and waste figures are starting points that you should check. Areas traced on satellite imagery are estimates and must be confirmed on site. You are responsible for the prices you quote, the work you agree to do, the taxes you charge and your compliance with the laws that apply to your business and your clients.

Proposal links and acceptance

A proposal link carries the proposal inside the link, and Metrado does not host or verify it. The "Accept" button opens a message from your client to you; it is not a signature and Metrado does not check who sent it. Metrado can also record a signature drawn on your phone or an acceptance you mark yourself. Whether any of these is enforceable depends on the law that applies to your contract, and you are responsible for using a suitable process for your work. Clients should check a document by phone before paying, as explained on the check page.

Referrals

If the invite feature is available, rewards depend on conditions shown in the app (for example, the friend's subscription, activity and eligibility), may change, have no cash value, and may be withheld for self-referral or abuse.

Acceptable use

Do not use Metrado to break the law, to send spam or misleading documents, to infringe others' rights, or to probe, overload or reverse-engineer the service except where the law allows it.

Our intellectual property

Metrado, its software, design and brand belong to us or our licensors. These terms give you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable right to use the app for your business while you follow them.

Third-party services

Metrado works with services such as Apple, Apple Maps, RevenueCat and the messaging apps you use to send documents. Their terms apply to your use of them, and we are not responsible for their services.

Disclaimers

We work hard to keep Metrado accurate and available, but we provide it "as is" and "as available". To the extent the law allows, we do not promise that it will be uninterrupted or without errors, or that calculations based on your inputs will fit your job.

Limitation of liability

To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential losses, lost profits or lost business, and our total liability to you for any claim is limited to the greater of the amount you paid us for Metrado in the 12 months before the claim and USD 100. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law, or rights you have as a consumer.

Ending these terms

You can stop using Metrado at any time. We may suspend or end your access if you seriously or repeatedly break these terms.

Changes to these terms

We may update these terms and will post the new version here with a new date. If a change is material, we will say so in the app. If you do not agree, you may stop using Metrado and cancel your subscription.

Law and disputes

These terms are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This does not take away the mandatory consumer-protection rights that the law of the country where you live gives you (for example in the United States, the European Union, the United Kingdom or Mexico). Those rights continue to apply to you whatever these terms say.

If you have a problem, please write to alhassan.mu@gmail.com first so we can try to resolve it informally. This is a request, not a condition: nothing in these terms stops you from contacting your local consumer authority, using any dispute process your law gives you, or going to court. If you are a consumer, you may bring a claim in the courts of the country where you live where your local law gives you that right, and we will not ask you to give up any right that cannot be waived. Subject to that, and to the extent the law allows, disputes that cannot be resolved informally are for the competent courts of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Languages

These terms are available in English, Spanish and Arabic. If the versions differ, the English version applies, except where local law requires otherwise.
